entities.name: Franz von Rintelen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Captain Franz Dagobert Johannes von Rintelen was a member of the German nobility and a veteran field agent in the intelligence wing of the German Imperial Navy who operated covertly in the still-neutral United States during World War I.
